sites.enforcement_snippet:
if requested_qty > item.available:
    raise InsufficientInventoryError(f"Requested {requested_qty} exceeds available {item.available}")

domain_notes: reserve_stock rejects a request larger than available stock, guarded by a single comparison. Both existing tests request at or below availability (4 of 10, and 5 of 5); neither requests more than available, so the overdraw rejection path is never exercised.
rationale: Selected reserve_stock because its quantity comparison is the sole enforcement and no test requests an overdraw.
